The record temperatures reflect a new normal for global climate conditions.

story_report.summary: August brought record-level global heat, with temperatures estimated at 1.65°C above pre-industrial levels. The concurrent heat over land and oceans adds to risks for communities, economies and ecosystems, Copernicus said.
